main.sub-title: Assistive basketball device for visually impaired

about.about-content: The GoalFinder is a device aimed at assisting visually impaired and blind  at playing basketball by playing sounds and illuminating a target strip to indicate the basket. It also provides visual and auditory feedback for successful shots. Furthermore, it's easy to set up and configure the GoalFinder web app, which lets users set up and play different games and challenges.

mission.mission-0-content: People with visual impairments should be full societal members, not burdens; equally included in daily life and sports. Thus, we developed the GoalFinder to allow everyone to play basketball equally.
mission.mission-1-content: GoalFinder should not only provide accessibility but also stay accessible to everyone. By keeping the project 100% open source, we ensure the full functionality is available to all at any time.
mission.mission-2-content: A real open-source project thrives only when supported by its community. We deeply appreciate feedback from our users and encourage developers to contribute their skills and ideas.

features.features-step-1-content: Mount and set up the GoalFinder. Use the Web App to make further adjustments and launch games or challenges
features.features-step-2-content: With the GoalFinder, a customizable sound and flashing light strip guides players to the basket.
features.features-step-3-content: The GoalFinder provides both auditory and visual feedback for hits and misses, while also giving real-time insights into the gameplay

quote.quote: With the Goalfinder project, the students of HTL Leonding impressively demonstrate what innovation can achieve. ... This project combines cutting-edge technology with social responsibility – thereby making a valuable contribution to our society.

awards.award-0-content: New technologies for people with disabilities
awards.award-1-content: Promoting social engagement and societal awareness among youth

documentation-about.doc-content: As a open source project we want to provide a as detailed as possible documentation. Both for casual or new users in a non tech focused way as well as for those interested in the GoalFinder's technology.

cta.cta-content: Join our community and help make basketball accessible for everyone.

doc-contrib.doc-card-content: Our documentation provides basic information about how the GoalFinder works, instructions on mounting, setting up, and usage, a comprehensive build guide, as well as a deep dive into the technology powering the device.
doc-contrib.contrib-card-content:
Ready to contribute?
Become a part of our community and help make basketball more accessible to visually impaired.
No matter if you only want to give feedback or want to actively take part. All contributions are welcome.
